questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(13, 65, 117)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is

13 × 5 = 65, 13 × 9 = 117

Similarly,

15 × 5 = 75, 15 × 9 = 135

Hence, (15, 75, 135) is the correct answer.

questions.question: If each letter of the English alphabet is assigned an odd numerical value in increasing order, such as A = 1, B = 3 and so on then what will be the code of HONEY?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee18a7e6c9c120a9ee8d4f7b736bb3eb8644f0023025f54b58cf76c364745566.png] 

According to the question :

If the positional value of a letter is "n", then the code of the letter will be "2n - 1".

H = 15, O = 29, N = 27, E = 9 and Y = 49

Therefore, the code for ‘HONEY’ is ‘152927949’

Hence, ‘152927949’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All parakeets are cuckoos.

2. All cuckoos are rabbits.

3. All rabbits are snakes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All parakeets are snakes.

II. All snakes are cuckoos.

III. All rabbits are parakeets.

IV. All cuckoos are snakes.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and IV follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bccaae059df32175cf4f2664970e2a45d7aa2d24c6b2de7856072c835f68019.png] 

I. All parakeets are snakes. → True (All parakeets are cuckoos, All cuckoos are rabbits and, All rabbits are snakes.)

II. All snakes are cuckoos. → False(it is possible but not definite)

III. All rabbits are parakeets. → False (it is possible but not definite)

IV. All cuckoos are snakes. → True(All cuckoos are rabbits and All rabbits are snakes.)

Hence, Only conclusions I and IV follow.

Select the set of letterers that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series will complete the series.

f_ hg _ fh _ gf _ hg _ fh _ g

options.text: h, f, g, h, f, f
f, g, h, f, g, f
g, f, g, f, h, f
g, h, f, g, h, f

questions.solution:
1) h, f, g, h, f, h → f __h __h / g __f __f /h __g__ g / f __h __h / g __f __f /h f__ __g → does not follow any pattern.

2) f, g, h, f, g, f → f f h / g g f / h __h __g / f __f __h / g __g__ f / h __f__ g → does not follow any pattern.

3) g, f, g, f, h, f → f __g__ h / g __f__ f / h __g__ g / f __f__ h / g __h__ f / h __f__ g → does not follow any pattern.

4) g, h, f, g, h, f →** f __g__ h / g __h__ f / h __f__ g** / f __g__ h / g __h__ f / h __f__ g → follows a pattern.

‘f g h / g h f / h f g’ repeats a cyclic pattern.

Hence, ‘g, h, f, g, h, f’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Shaan has a total Rs. 5,500 with him. He buys product ‘z’ at Rs. 5,000 from this sum and then sells it to another person, thus making a profit of 15% on it. With all the money he has now, he buys product ‘X’ and then sells it to another person making a profit of 25% on it. What is the total money Shaan has now?
questions.solution:
Given:

Total Amount is Rs. 5,500.

Product ‘z’ bought at Rs. 5000.

Therefore, the remaining amount is 500.

Product ‘z’ sell at 15% profit.

SP = 5000 times frac{{115}}{{100}} = 5750

Now total amount is = 500 + 5750

= 6250

Now he buys product ‘X’ at Rs. 6250 and then sell it at 25% profit then the total remaining amount

= 6250 times frac{{125}}{{100}} = 7812.50

Hence, ’Rs. 7812.50’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Arrange the following in a logical sequence from small to big.

1) Crocodile

2) Lizard

3) Whale

4) Housefly

5) Monkey
questions.solution:
The correct logical sequence is,

Housefly → Lizard → Monkey → Crocodile → Whale

All are arranged in increasing order according to their physical size.

Hence, ‘4, 2, 5, 1, 3’ is the correct sequence.

questions.question: In a certain code language, U is written as C, K is written as H, L is written as U, N is written as E, S is written as L, E is written as K, and C is written as N. How will ‘KNUCKLES’ be written in that language?
questions.solution:
U → C, K → H, L → U, N → E, S → L, E → K, and C → N

So, ’KNUCKLES’ is written as ‘HECNHUKL’.

Hence, ’HECNHUKL’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Four position of the same dice are shown. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing ‘3’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01684f19130ed6e42876256172dfdf2d02447db55f4f12d8da4bd2cfc68cf6f1.png]
questions.solution:
4 is adjacent to 2 and 3 in the first position of the dice.

3 is adjacent to 4 and 6 in the second position of the dice.

3 is adjacent to 6 and 1 in the third position of the dice.

3 is adjacent to 1 and 4 in the fourth position of the dice.

The only number left is 5.

Hence, 3 is opposite to 5.
